lines: symfony-security-auditor <VERSION> (symfony/models-dev <PACKAGE-VERSION>)
Usage:
command [options] [arguments]
Options:
-h, --help            Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
--silent          Do not output any message
-q, --quiet           Only errors are displayed. All other output is suppressed
-V, --version         Display this application version
--ansi|--no-ansi  Force (or disable --no-ansi) ANSI output
-n, --no-interaction  Do not ask any interactive question
-v|vv|vvv, --verbose  Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug
Available commands:
completion      Dump the shell completion script
doctor          Check that the environment is ready to run an audit
help            Display help for a command
init            Create the standalone configuration and download the selected provider bridge
list            List commands
self-update     Update the standalone binary to the latest released version
audit
audit:baseline  Create or update an accepted-finding baseline from a JSON audit report, preserving existing entries and their reasons
audit:diff      Compare two previously generated JSON audit reports and show new, fixed, and persisting findings
audit:run       [audit] Run AI-powered multi-agent security audit on a Symfony project
audit:trend     Track how finding counts evolve across two or more JSON audit reports ordered oldest to newest
auth
auth:remove     Forget the API key stored on this machine
auth:set        Store the provider API key on this machine, in a file only you can read
auth:status     Show which API key an audit would use, without printing it
mcp
mcp:serve       Start a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio exposing the auditor as tools (experimental)
